header.system:
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

The DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout is at C:\Users\limer\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from this path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI at http://127.0.0.1:3080. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

You are a coding agent powered by the deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp model. Your working directory is C:\Users\limer\Desktop\motor-drive\Soft.

Paths prefixed with @ are files explicitly referenced by the user. Use the read tool when their contents are needed; do not claim to have inspected a file before reading it.

Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat — to inspect text files. Results include line numbers. Use offset and limit to continue reading large files.

Use the write tool to create files or completely replace file contents. Existing files are overwritten, so read an existing file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it) and prefer edit for targeted changes.

Use the edit tool for targeted changes to existing UTF-8 text files. It replaces literal old_string with new_string; by default old_string must appear exactly once. If old_string appears multiple times, provide a more specific old_string or set replace_all to true. Read the file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it), unless you just created or edited it in this session.

Use the glob tool — not shell find — to discover files by path pattern. A pattern with no "/" matches basenames at any depth, so "*" matches every file in the tree rather than its top level. Results are files only, never directories, and include hidden and ignored files: a result that fits comes back in modification-time order, while a larger one keeps the modification-time-ordered head.

Use the grep tool — not shell grep or rg — to search file contents. Use read on a matched file when you need surrounding context.

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

Use the web_search tool to discover current information on the web. The required queries array accepts 1–4 non-empty search queries; use a one-item array for a single search. It returns an optional answer plus a list of source URLs. Use the returned source snippets when available, and cite the relevant URLs as markdown links.

Use goal tools for one long-running completion objective in the current session. create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language; do not create a goal for routine single-turn work. Call get_goal before update_goal and copy its exact goal_id and revision. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Use subagent in the background by default. Start independent delegations together in one assistant message and continue useful work while they run. Set `run_in_background: false` only when your next action depends on that subagent's result. When a background run settles, the runtime sends you a notice containing its outcome and any final assistant message.

Use subagent_fork in the background by default. Start independent delegations together in one assistant message and continue useful work while they run. Set `run_in_background: false` only when your next action depends on that subagent's result. When a background run settles, the runtime sends you a notice containing its outcome and any final assistant message.

When you successfully create or modify files, mention the primary outputs in your final response. To make those and any other changed-file references clickable in Web, format them as Markdown inline code using the exact file-tool path, or a basename when unique among the files changed in that turn.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding. Send one or more questions, each with a stable id that will be echoed in the answer.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create one persisted same-session completion goal when the current direct human request is a long-running objective that should continue across autonomous goal rounds. You may infer that intent without requiring the user to say "create a goal". Do not use this for trivial single-turn work. Execution rejects non-human and subagent authority.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

old_string.description: Literal text to replace. Must match exactly.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this file operation needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of an operation the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. Send the COMPLETE plan as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current same-session goal, including its exact id/revision, objective, phase, completed continuation rounds, round limit, blocker reason when present, and whether another continuation is armed. Call this before updating a goal.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files whose paths match a glob pattern. Returns matching file paths — never directories — including hidden and ignored files (VCS metadata directories are excluded). Up to 100 paths come back in modification-time order; a larger result returns the first 100 paths in modification-time order, says so, and reports where the complete sorted list was saved. This tool does not enumerate directory entries.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns the first 250 matches inline; a capped result reports where the complete match list was saved. Use read on a matched file for surrounding context.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Request cancellation of a background agent's current turn by its agent id. The target may be your direct child or a deeper agent created under you. Only the current turn stops: messages already queued for the agent stay parked until a later send_message, agents it started keep running, and the agent itself stays available for follow-ups. This call returns as soon as the stop request is accepted, so the target may keep running briefly; interrupting an agent that already finished is an accepted no-op.

agent_id.description: The agent id of the running agent to interrupt.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job by job id. Returns immediately; the job settles as killed once its work actually stops.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job. Stream jobs return only output since the previous read; final-output jobs return their result after settlement. Every response ends with `[status: ...]`. Reads are non-blocking unless `wait: true`, which waits up to the configured cap.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job reaches a terminal status or the timeout expires. A timed-out wait returns [status: running] and leaves the job alive.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds (only meaningful with wait: true). Defaults to the configured wait timeout; capped by the configured maximum.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List your continuable background subagents by durable id and label. Use it to recall which ones you started, not to poll for completion — you are told when one finishes. Status comes from the live registry: running means the agent is working right now, idle means it is loaded but between turns (it may be waiting on agents it started), and ready means it exists only in storage — resumable, not terminal, and not a result waiting to be collected; a `send_message` starts a new turn on the same conversation, and a direct child remains a `send_message` candidate in every status. The snapshot is not a delivery promise — `send_message` performs the authoritative check and may still fail. Children that could not be read are reported as diagnostics instead of being silently dropped. Scope `descendants` walks the whole tree below you in stable pre-order, annotating each entry with its durable direct-parent session id and depth. You may use `send_message` only for depth-1 entries; deeper entries are candidates for `interrupt_agent` only.

scope.description: children (default) lists direct children only; descendants walks the complete tree below you.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process: no state (cwd, variables, functions) persists between calls — pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]`. Current harness environment facts are exposed through managed `$env:DSH_*` variables; inspect them when needed. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]` — a policy denial, not a bug in the command; do not retry another way. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Set `run_in_background: true` for long-running commands: the call returns a job id immediately; read its output with `job_output` and stop it with `job_kill`. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output. Attempting a command the sandbox may deny is safe and expected: run it and read the marker rather than assuming the denial. When a command is denied and a wider mode would let it succeed, escalate immediately in the same turn — the one sanctioned exception to a denial: retry the exact same command once with `sandbox_permissions` (the narrowest wider mode that suffices) plus a one-sentence `justification`. Do not detour through chat to ask permission first — the approval prompt raised by that retry is how the user consents. If the session states approval prompts are disabled, there is no exception: a denial is final — do not set `sandbox_permissions`. Never escalate speculatively: ground the request in a real denial — normally the one this command just hit; escalating up front is fine only when this session already denied the same access. A rejected escalation is final for that command — stop and explain, never work around it — but it does not forbid attempting or escalating other commands later.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap, and kills the command on expiry.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this command needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of a command the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access.

tools.name: ralph
tools.description: Run a foreground fresh-agent Ralph loop toward one immutable objective. Use only when the direct human explicitly asks for Ralph or fresh-agent iteration. Each round opens a new child with no parent conversation or prior child session; the shared workspace is long-term memory, and only a bounded structured report crosses rounds. The call returns when a worker reports completion or a concrete blocker, or at the round limit. Ordinary long-running same-session work belongs to goal tools.

objective.description: The immutable completion objective for every fresh Ralph round.

maxRounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer round cap, bounded by the deployment ceiling.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Harness validates and downscales large supported images before the next model request, so use this tool directly instead of installing image libraries or creating thumbnails merely to inspect an image. Independent files may be read concurrently in small batches. Requires the current model to accept image input.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a background subagent by its subagent id, continuing the same conversation. It becomes the subagent's next turn: if it is still working, the message waits until its current turn finishes, so it cannot redirect work already underway. This call returns no answer from the subagent — only confirmation that the message was delivered — so use it to give it more work. A failure means the message was NOT delivered.

subagent_id.description: The subagent id returned when the background subagent was started.

message.description: The message to deliver to the subagent.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for an available skill. Call this with the exact skill name from the session skill catalog before acting on a task that names or clearly matches that skill.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. Give it a complete, standalone prompt: it does not see this conversation. This tool runs in the background by default, immediately returns a durable subagent id, and keeps the child conversation available for later turns. When that run settles, the runtime sends the parent a notice containing its outcome and any final assistant message; `send_message` starts a later turn in the same child conversation. Set `run_in_background: false` only when your next action depends on receiving the result.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

run_in_background.description: Whether to run in the background and return a durable subagent id immediately. Defaults to true. Set false to wait for the result when your next action depends on it.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool runs in the background by default, immediately returns a durable subagent id, and keeps the child conversation available for later turns. When that run settles, the runtime sends the parent a notice containing its outcome and any final assistant message; `send_message` starts a later turn in the same child conversation. Set `run_in_background: false` only when your next action depends on receiving the result.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

run_in_background.description: Whether to run in the background and return a durable subagent id immediately. Defaults to true. Set false to wait for the result when your next action depends on it.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Record and update a structured task list for the current work. Send the ENTIRE list every call — it REPLACES the previous list (there are no partial updates, no per-item edits). Use it to plan multi-step work and show progress: add one todo per concrete step before you start. Mark every todo being actively worked on `in_progress` — several at once when work genuinely runs in parallel (e.g. concurrent subagents or background commands), one for sequential work; while work remains, at least one task should be `in_progress`. Mark a todo `completed` the moment it is done (do not batch completions), and allow no `in_progress` item only once all work is complete. Skip the list for trivial single-step tasks. Statuses: `pending` (not started), `in_progress` (being worked on now), `completed` (finished).

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update the exact current goal revision. edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. During an automatic continuation of the current goal, complete and blocked are also allowed. blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count; the model remains responsible for judging that the same condition persisted across those rounds and must explain it in blocked_reason.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Concrete blocking condition; required only with action blocked.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information. Provide 1–4 queries in the required queries array. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs.

queries.description: Required search queries; accepts 1–4 items and merges their results.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

The workflow's identity rides the `meta` parameter as JSON: required `name` (short kebab-case) and `description` strings, optional `whenToUse` string and `phases` array (`{title, detail?, provider?, model?}`). The `script` parameter is the plain JavaScript body ONLY (NOT TypeScript, and NO `export const meta` statement — meta is a parameter, not code), running with top-level await; end with `return <value>` — the value must be JSON-serializable and is this tool's result.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf — no pattern/format/numeric bounds) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides (either may be provided alone). Anything else (`effort`/`isolation`/`agentType`) is rejected loudly.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. An ordinary stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) throw errors that ALWAYS kill the script — they never dissolve into a per-item `null`.

Constraints: concurrency and total-agent caps apply; no filesystem, network, timers, or Node.js APIs are provided — the agents do the work, the script only coordinates them. The run executes in the foreground: this call returns when the whole script finishes.

script.description: The plain-JS workflow script body (top-level await allowed; NO `export const meta` statement; end with `return <json-value>`).

meta.description: The workflow identity block (plain JSON — never code).

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this file operation needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of an operation the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.

lines.text: # Role: 嵌入式与硬件开发架构助手
你是一名严谨的嵌入式系统架构与全栈开发专家。在协助我完成项目开发时，严格遵守以下四个工作阶段与记忆隔离规范：
## 阶段一：芯片情报检索与本地缓存（Cache First）
1. **本地嗅探**：获取芯片型号后，优先检查当前工作目录是否存在 `[芯片型号].md`（如 `STM32F103C8T6.md`）。
- 若文件已存在，仅读取已有内容，**严禁重复联网搜索已有信息**。
- 若发现缺失具体外设参数、寄存器配置或电气特性，仅对未知部分进行针对性联网检索。
- 将检索到的新模块/引脚定义/踩坑注意项**增量追加**写入该文件，形成长期硬件知识库。
## 阶段二：方案可行性核对与关键决策询问（Pause & Ask）
1. 评估功能需求在当前硬件资源下的可行性（时钟、引脚复用、RAM/Flash 开销、总线冲突）。
2. 形成初步系统框架后，**必须暂停并主动向我提问确认以下关键项**，严禁擅自提前编写具体工程计划：
- **实现路径与协议**（如：轮询/中断/DMA、Modbus RTU/CAN/MQTT）
- **开发环境与工具链**（如：Keil MDK / STM32CubeIDE / ESP-IDF / VS Code + PlatformIO / Qt Creator）
- **三方库或框架依赖**（如：FreeRTOS / HAL / LL库 / LVGL）
## 阶段三：结构化开发计划（Action Plan）
在我明确指定软件环境与实现方式后，制定阶段性执行计划：
- 拆解为原子化任务步骤（环境初始化 -> 外设驱动配置 -> 协议栈/业务逻辑 -> 联调测试）。
- 明确各环节的交付物与验收标准。
## 阶段四：专项工作记忆隔离与复盘（Context Isolation）
为了保持上下文聚焦并方便回溯，按工作类型分别记录以下独立文件：
1. **代码编写与调试记忆 (`dev_notes.md`)**：
- 记录核心架构设计、关键函数接口与全局状态设计。
- **Bug 追踪表**：严格记录「遇到的错误现象 -> 排查过程 -> 根本原因 -> 最终解决方案」，避免后续同类任务再次踩坑。
2. **图文与原理图分析记忆 (`analysis_notes.md`)**：
- 记录原理图引脚连接、时序波形分析、传感器数据帧图解等结构化提炼信息。
3. **查阅机制**：在执行代码编写或图文解析前，优先快速读取对应的记忆文件，继承已有成果。

69: | R7–R9 | 20 kΩ | 3 | 低边管源极 → GND（见问题③） |

101: ---
102: 
103: ## 5. 设计校核
104: 
105: | 项 | 计算 / 判断 |
106: |---|---|
107: | 辅助电源输出电压 | VCC = V_FB × (1 + 8.66k/1k) ≈ 1.25 V × 9.66 ≈ **12.1 V**（按 XL7005A 的 1.25 V 基准；请对数据手册确认） |
108: | 12 V 驱动电压 | 对 100 V 级 MOSFET 属合理区间，栅极电阻 10 Ω 也合理 |
109: | 自举电容 200 nF | 容量偏大但可用（典型 100 nF～1 µF）；ES1D（1 A/200 V，快恢复）做自举二极管合适 |
110: | 母线电解 | 3×47 µF + 100 µF + 100 nF，容量对中小功率电机足够，但**位置离高边管很远** |
111: | 降压电感 47 µH | XL7005A 规格：Vin 5–80 V、Vout 1.25–20 V、**Iout 最大 0.4 A**、fsw 固定 **150 kHz**、Iq 2.5 mA。VCC 实际负载很轻（≈ 10–40 mA），此时工作在 DCM，峰值电流 `I_pk = √(2·Io·Vout·(Vin−Vout)/(L·fsw·Vin))` ≈ **0.21–0.27 A** → **47 µH 在轻载下可用**。但 47 µH 使变换器在全负载范围内始终处于 DCM：满载 0.4 A 时峰值达 **0.83–1.08 A**，会撞上内部开关限流 → **VCC 的实际可用电流被限制在几十至一百多 mA**。若希望吃满 0.4 A，需换 **470–680 µH**。详见 `修复方案.md` F8 |
112: | MOSFET 耐压 | 100 V 器件，母线建议长期工作 ≤ 48 V（留 50% 余量） |
113: | 保护 | **无采样电阻、无过流比较、无母线 TVS、无刹车电路**；FD6288T 本身也不含 ITRIP |
114: 
115: ---
116: 
117: ## 6. 发现的问题（按严重程度排序）
118: 
119: ### ① U1 的 6 个 PWM 输入引脚全部悬空（致命）
120: HIN1/HIN2/HIN3（1/2/3）与 LIN1/LIN2/LIN3（4/5/6）在图上**只有引脚端点的灰色小圆点，没有任何导线或网络标签**（放大图已确认），整张图也没有任何连接器。也就是说：
121: - 没有任何信号源能驱动这 6 个输入；
122: - 该页无法独立工作，且换相/调速接口缺失。
123: （若 FD6288T 输入内部无下拉，浮空输入还可能因干扰导致上下桥直通。）
124: 
125: ### ② U2（XL7005A）的 EN(4) 直接接地（致命）
126: 高亮追踪显示：`U2.EN(4)` 与 `U2.GND(5,6,7,8)`、`U1.COM(8)` 属于**同一个网络**（就是 GND）。按常规高有效使能定义，这会把降压芯片**永久关断**，VCC 永远起不来，栅极驱动器没有供电，整板不工作。
127: （EN 通常应接 VIN 或经分压接 VIN。）
128: 
129: ### ③ 三个低边 MOSFET 的源极只通过 20 kΩ 到地（致命）
130: Q1.S、Q5.S、Q4.S 的源极节点唯一的对外连接就是 R7/R8/R9 = 20 kΩ，再接到 GND 符号。**没有源极直连功率地的走线**。
131: 后果：低边管无法回流电机电流，半桥不能工作（20 kΩ 不可能是功率回路）。
132: 看起来像是"把 20 kΩ 当作栅源下拉电阻放上了，但漏掉了源极直接接地"。
133: 
134: ### ④ C8/C9/C10（3 × 1 µF）挂在了降压开关节点 SW 上（严重）
135: U2.SW(2) 通过一条**横穿整张图**的走线（y≈316 → 右端 x≈773.6 竖直干线）连到了：
136: - C8/C9/C10 各 1 µF（另一端接 GND）→ **开关节点对地挂了 3 µF**；
137: - D1/D2/D3 三个自举二极管的阳极。
138: 
139: 后果：开关节点上 3 µF 会造成极大的开关尖峰电流与损耗，可能直接损坏 XL7005A 内部开关管，同时是极强的 EMI 源；自举供电取自开关节点也是错的（应从 VCC 12 V 取）。
140: 从器件选型与摆放看，这三个 1 µF 与自举二极管的本意应该是接 **VCC_BUS 去耦 / VCC 供电**，即**该走线接错了一个节点**。
141: 
142: ### ⑤ 布局/去耦相关（一般）
143: - 母线电解（C15/C16/C17、C14）离三只高边管很远，高 di/dt 回路面积大；
144: - XL7005A 的 VIN 通过一条很长的走线取自母线，输入端附近没有就近的陶瓷电容（C2/C14 在另一头）；
145: - SW 节点走线横穿整板，是主要的辐射源。
146: 
147: ### ⑥ 缺少保护功能（一般）
148: 无过流采样/比较、无母线过压/TVS、无续流刹车、无明显自举欠压保护（依赖 FD6288T 内部 UVLO）。
149: 
150: ---
151: 
152: ## 7. 结论
153: 
154: - 这张图描述了"**FD6288T + 6×100 V MOSFET 三相逆变 + XL7005A 12 V 辅助电源**"这一常见且合理的拓扑，器件选型方向基本正确；
155: - 但**当前版本存在至少 3 处致命连线问题（PWM 输入悬空、EN 接地、低边源极未接地）和 1 处严重布线错误（SW 节点挂 3 µF + 自举取自 SW）**，按现状打样不可能正常工作；
156: - 图框显示创建 2026-09-03、更新 2026-09-08，1 页共 1 页，无连接器 —— 这更像一份**未完成/未校对的草稿**，而不是可投产版本。
157: 
158: 建议按上面 ①～④ 逐条修改后再复核，并补充：连接器（电源/三相/PWM）、过流保护、母线就近陶瓷去耦。
159: 
160: ---
161: 
162: ## 附：本次分析产出的文件（均在 `_analysis/`）
163: 
164: | 文件 | 说明 |
165: |---|---|
166: | `sheet.png` / `sheet.svg` | 从 PDF 几何重建的整页原理图（可用于复核） |
167: | `base.png` | 6 倍分辨率底图（用于局部放大） |
168: | `parsed.json` | 解析出的全部文字与图元（文本/路径/颜色/坐标） |
169: | `final_nets.txt` / `nets.txt` | 提取出的网络 ↔ 器件对应表 |
170: | `*.mjs` | 解析、建图、网表、渲染、高亮等脚本 |

## 3. 完整元件清单（38 个位号）
| 位号 | 型号 / 参数 | 数量 | 作用 |
| U1 | FD6288T（20 脚，三相栅极驱动） | 1 | 三相半桥驱动，含自举 |
| U2 | XL7005A（SOP-8，降压 DC-DC） | 1 | VCC_BUS → 12 V 辅助电源 |
| D1–D3 | ES1D（1 A 快恢复） | 3 | 自举二极管 |
| D5 | SS110-LTP（1 A 肖特基） | 1 | 降压续流二极管 |
| L1 | 47 µH | 1 | 降压电感 |
| R1–R6 | 10 Ω | 6 | 6 只 MOSFET 的栅极电阻 |
| R7–R9 | 20 kΩ | 3 | 低边管源极 → GND（见问题③） |
| R10 / R11 | 8.66 kΩ / 1 kΩ | 2 | 降压反馈分压 |
| C8–C10 | 1 µF | 3 | 见问题④（当前接在 SW 上） |
| C15–C17 | 47 µF 电解 | 3 | 母线电解电容 |
| C14 | 100 µF 电解 | 1 | 母线电解电容 |
| C2 | 100 nF | 1 | 母线高频去耦 |
| C1 | 1 µF | 1 | U1 的 VCC 去耦 |
**没有连接器**（无 J / P / CN 位号）。相线 A/B/C、母线 VCC_BUS、GND 全部只靠网络标签或电源符号表达。
## 4. 提取出的关键网表
| 网络 | 挂在网络上的器件 |
| `VCC_BUS` | Q2.D、Q3.D、Q6.D（三个高边漏极）、U2.VIN、C2、C14、C15、C16、C17 |
| `SW`（U2 开关节点） | U2.SW、L1 下端、D5 阴极，**并经长走线到 C8/C9/C10 与 D1/D2/D3 阳极** |
| FB | R10 下端、R11 上端、U2.FB(3) |
| `A` / `B` / `C` | 三个半桥中点；U1.VS1/VS2/VS3 分别取自这三个点 |
| 自举 | VB1↔C5↔D1 阴极；VB2↔C6↔D2；VB3↔C7↔D3 |
| 栅极 | LO1→R1→Q1.G；LO2→R2→Q5.G；LO3→R3→Q4.G；HO1→R6→Q2.G；HO2→R5→Q3.G；HO3→R4→Q6.G |
| 低边源极 | Q1.S、Q5.S、Q4.S **仅**经 R7/R8/R9（20 kΩ）到 GND |
U1 引脚序号是从图上读出的（与 FD6288T 的 SOP-20 定义一致）：
## 5. 设计校核
| 项 | 计算 / 判断 |
| 辅助电源输出电压 | VCC = V_FB × (1 + 8.66k/1k) ≈ 1.25 V × 9.66 ≈ **12.1 V**（按 XL7005A 的 1.25 V 基准；请对数据手册确认） |
| 12 V 驱动电压 | 对 100 V 级 MOSFET 属合理区间，栅极电阻 10 Ω 也合理 |
| 自举电容 200 nF | 容量偏大但可用（典型 100 nF～1 µF）；ES1D（1 A/200 V，快恢复）做自举二极管合适 |
| 母线电解 | 3×47 µF + 100 µF + 100 nF，容量对中小功率电机足够，但**位置离高边管很远** |

| 降压电感 47 µH | XL7005A 规格：Vin 5–80 V、Vout 1.25–20 V、**Iout 最大 0.4 A**、fsw 固定 **150 kHz**、Iq 2.5 mA。VCC 实际负载很轻（≈ 10–40 mA），此时工作在 DCM，峰值电流 `I_pk = √(2·Io·Vout·(Vin−Vout)/(L·fsw·Vin))` ≈ **0.21–0.27 A** → **47 µH 在轻载下可用**。但 47 µH 使变换器在全负载范围内始终处于 DCM：满载 0.4 A 时峰值达 **0.83–1.08 A**，会撞上内部开关限流 → **VCC 的实际可用电流被限制在几十至一百多 mA**。若希望吃满 0.4 A，需换 **470–680 µH**。详见 `修复方案.md` F8 |
| MOSFET 耐压 | 100 V 器件，母线建议长期工作 ≤ 48 V（留 50% 余量） |
| 保护 | **无采样电阻、无过流比较、无母线 TVS、无刹车电路**；FD6288T 本身也不含 ITRIP |
## 6. 发现的问题（按严重程度排序）
### ① U1 的 6 个 PWM 输入引脚全部悬空（致命）
HIN1/HIN2/HIN3（1/2/3）与 LIN1/LIN2/LIN3（4/5/6）在图上**只有引脚端点的灰色小圆点，没有任何导线或网络标签**（放大图已确认），整张图也没有任何连接器。也就是说：
- 没有任何信号源能驱动这 6 个输入；
- 该页无法独立工作，且换相/调速接口缺失。
（若 FD6288T 输入内部无下拉，浮空输入还可能因干扰导致上下桥直通。）
### ② U2（XL7005A）的 EN(4) 直接接地（致命）
高亮追踪显示：`U2.EN(4)` 与 `U2.GND(5,6,7,8)`、`U1.COM(8)` 属于**同一个网络**（就是 GND）。按常规高有效使能定义，这会把降压芯片**永久关断**，VCC 永远起不来，栅极驱动器没有供电，整板不工作。
（EN 通常应接 VIN 或经分压接 VIN。）
### ③ 三个低边 MOSFET 的源极只通过 20 kΩ 到地（致命）
Q1.S、Q5.S、Q4.S 的源极节点唯一的对外连接就是 R7/R8/R9 = 20 kΩ，再接到 GND 符号。**没有源极直连功率地的走线**。
后果：低边管无法回流电机电流，半桥不能工作（20 kΩ 不可能是功率回路）。
看起来像是"把 20 kΩ 当作栅源下拉电阻放上了，但漏掉了源极直接接地"。
### ④ C8/C9/C10（3 × 1 µF）挂在了降压开关节点 SW 上（严重）
U2.SW(2) 通过一条**横穿整张图**的走线（y≈316 → 右端 x≈773.6 竖直干线）连到了：
- C8/C9/C10 各 1 µF（另一端接 GND）→ **开关节点对地挂了 3 µF**；
- D1/D2/D3 三个自举二极管的阳极。
后果：开关节点上 3 µF 会造成极大的开关尖峰电流与损耗，可能直接损坏 XL7005A 内部开关管，同时是极强的 EMI 源；自举供电取自开关节点也是错的（应从 VCC 12 V 取）。
从器件选型与摆放看，这三个 1 µF 与自举二极管的本意应该是接 **VCC_BUS 去耦 / VCC 供电**，即**该走线接错了一个节点**。
### ⑤ 布局/去耦相关（一般）
- 母线电解（C15/C16/C17、C14）离三只高边管很远，高 di/dt 回路面积大；
- XL7005A 的 VIN 通过一条很长的走线取自母线，输入端附近没有就近的陶瓷电容（C2/C14 在另一头）；
- SW 节点走线横穿整板，是主要的辐射源。
### ⑥ 缺少保护功能（一般）
无过流采样/比较、无母线过压/TVS、无续流刹车、无明显自举欠压保护（依赖 FD6288T 内部 UVLO）。
- 这张图描述了"**FD6288T + 6×100 V MOSFET 三相逆变 + XL7005A 12 V 辅助电源**"这一常见且合理的拓扑，器件选型方向基本正确；
- 但**当前版本存在至少 3 处致命连线问题（PWM 输入悬空、EN 接地、低边源极未接地）和 1 处严重布线错误（SW 节点挂 3 µF + 自举取自 SW）**，按现状打样不可能正常工作；
- 图框显示创建 2026-09-03、更新 2026-09-08，1 页共 1 页，无连接器 —— 这更像一份**未完成/未校对的草稿**，而不是可投产版本。
建议按上面 ①～④ 逐条修改后再复核，并补充：连接器（电源/三相/PWM）、过流保护、母线就近陶瓷去耦。
## 附：本次分析产出的文件（均在 `_analysis/`）

| `sheet.png` / `sheet.svg` | 从 PDF 几何重建的整页原理图（可用于复核） |
| `base.png` | 6 倍分辨率底图（用于局部放大） |

| `*.mjs` | 解析、建图、网表、渲染、高亮等脚本 |

<content>
1: # motor-driver V1.0 原理图整改清单
2: 
3: > 配套文件：`分析报告.md`（问题定位与证据）
4: > 图框信息：原理图 Schematic1 / 板子 Board1 / 1 页共 1 页 / V1.0 A3
5: 
6: ---
7: 
8: ## 修改项一览
9: 
10: | 编号 | 位置 | 动作 | 优先级 |
11: |---|---|---|---|
12: | F1 | U1 脚 1–6 | 引出 6 路 PWM 到连接器，并加 10 kΩ 下拉 | P0 |
13: | F2 | U2 脚 4 (EN) | 断开与 GND/COM 的连接，改接 VIN 或加 UVLO 分压 | P0 |
14: | F3 | Q1/Q5/Q4 源极 | 源极直接接功率地；R7/R8/R9 改作栅源下拉 | P0 |
15: | F4 | 右侧 x≈773.6 干线 | 从 SW 侧改接到 L1 之后的 VCC 节点 | P0 |
16: | F5 | D1–D3 阳极 | 必须取自 VCC (12 V)，不得取自 SW 或 VCC_BUS | P0 |
17: | F6 | C8–C10 | 明确用途后归位（VCC 就近去耦 或 母线陶瓷） | P1 |
18: | F7 | 全板 | 加电源/三相/PWM 连接器 | P1 |
19: | F8 | L1 | 确认 fsw 与输入耐压（47 µH 本身可用） | P2 |
20: | F9 | 保护 | 过流、母线 TVS、UVLO | P1 |
21: | F10 | 高边管 | 补 3 只栅源下拉 | P2 |
22: | F11 | 布局 | 高频回路最小化、就近去耦、开尔文地 | P2 |
23: 
24: ---
25: 
26: ## F1 · U1 的 6 路 PWM 输入悬空
27: 
28: **动作**
29: 1. HIN1(1)/HIN2(2)/HIN3(3)、LIN1(4)/LIN2(5)/LIN3(6) 各拉一条线到新增连接器。
30: 2. 每根输入线在驱动器一侧加 **10 kΩ 下拉到 GND**（防止悬空直通）。
31: 3. 若走线较长或与功率线并行，串 **100 Ω**（紧靠驱动器引脚）。
32: 
33: **连接器建议**：2.54 mm 1×8 排针 / JST-GH，定义为
34: `PWM1H, PWM1L, PWM2H, PWM2L, PWM3H, PWM3L, GND, 逻辑电源`
35: 
36: **验证**：断开 MCU 后，用示波器看 6 个引脚应为低电平；6 路输入全低时 HO/LO 应为低。
37: 
38: ---
39: 
40: ## F2 · U2 (XL7005A) 的 EN 接地
41: 
42: **根因**：EN 与 U2 的 GND(5–8)、U1 的 COM(8) 在同一个网络（= GND）。
43: 
44: **动作（三选一）**
45: - **A（最小改动）**：删除 EN→GND 的连线，把 EN 直接接到 VIN(1)。
46: - **B（推荐，带 UVLO）**：EN 经分压接 VCC_BUS
47:   - 目标：母线约 18 V 才启动
48:   - `R_up = 130 kΩ`（VCC_BUS → EN），`R_dn = 10 kΩ`（EN → GND）
49:   - EN 到 GND 再并 `100 nF` 滤波
50:   - 实测阈值 = V_EN(th) × (R_up+R_dn)/R_dn ≈ 1.25 V × 14 ≈ **17.5 V**
51: - **C**：由 MCU 的一个 GPIO 控制 EN（可做软启动/故障关断）。
52: 
53: **必做前置检查**：核对 XL7005A 数据手册，确认 **4 脚确实是 EN 且高电平有效**。若是低有效或内部上拉，则接法完全不同。
54: 
55: **验证**：上电后量 VCC 应为 ≈ 12.1 V（= 1.25 V × (1 + 8.66k/1k)）。
56: 
57: ---
58: 
59: ## F3 · 三个低边管源极只经 20 kΩ 到地
60: 
61: **根因**：Q1/Q5/Q4 的源极节点唯一的对外连接是 R7/R8/R9（20 kΩ）→ GND，没有源极直连。
62: 
63: **动作**
64: 1. **每个低边管的源极节点直接连到功率地**（铺铜 + 多过孔，不要细线）。
65: 2. 改完后 R7/R8/R9 变成 GND↔GND，失去作用 —— 把它们**改接到栅极**：
66:    `R7: Q1.G ↔ Q1.S`，`R8: Q5.G ↔ Q5.S`，`R9: Q4.G ↔ Q4.S`（保持 20 kΩ 即可，10–22 kΩ 均可）。
67: 3. 三个低边源极应汇聚到**同一个星点**，再把该星点单点连到 U1 的 COM(8) 和 U2 的 GND，避免栅极驱动回流串入功率地。
68: 4. 若后续要做电流采样：星点与功率地之间插入分流电阻，采样走差分开尔文线。
69: 
70: **验证**：断电用万用表量 Q1.S–Q5.S–Q4.S 之间应为 0 Ω；上电后电机可正常转动。
71: 
72: ---
73: 
74: ## F4 · SW 开关节点被引到图纸右侧干线
75: 
76: **根因**：U2.SW(2) 经 `(478.4,370.4) → (478.4,316.4) → (773.6,316.4)` 一条横穿整板的走线连到 x≈773.6 的竖直干线。
77: 
78: **动作**
79: 1. **删除** `(478.4,316.4)–(478.4,370.4)` 这段竖线以及 `(478.4,370.4)` 上的连接点。
80: 2. 让右侧干线改从 **L1 之后的 VCC 节点**取电（即 L1 上端 / C11 / C12 / R10 上端 / U1.VCC 那一网络）。
81: 3. 改完后 SW 网络只允许包含三样东西：`U2.SW(2)`、`L1` 下端、`D5` 阴极。
82: 4. SW 回路在 PCB 上必须**极短、极粗**：`U2.SW → L1 → D5 → C11 地` 围成的面积最小化，禁止跨越其他区域。
83: 
84: **验证**：用欧姆档量 SW 节点对 VCC 节点应为 L1 的直流电阻（≈0 Ω 但经电感），对 GND 不应有电容通路；上电后用示波器看 SW 波形应是干净方波，无异常振铃过冲。
85: 
86: ---
87: 
88: ## F5 · 自举二极管阳极供电
89: 
90: **原则**：D1/D2/D3 的**阳极必须接 VCC (12 V)**，阴极经自举电容接到 VB1/VB2/VB3。
91: 绝不能接 SW（开关节点）或 VCC_BUS（母线）—— 后者会把母线电压加在 VB–VS 之间，直接打坏驱动器。
92: 
93: **动作**
94: 1. 确认 F4 修改后，右侧干线就是 VCC (12 V)。
95: 2. 逐相确认：`D1.A → VCC`，`D1.K → VB1(20) 且 C5 → VB1↔VS1`；D2/D3 同理。
96: 
97: **验证**：上电且未换相时，量 VB1–VS1、VB2–VS2、VB3–VS3 均应为 ≈ 11.3 V（VCC 减去二极管压降）。
98: 
99: ---
100: 
101: ## F6 · C8/C9/C10 的归属（必须先定用途）
102: 
103: 这三只 1 µF 现在和 D1–D3 阳极同挂在右侧干线上，说明**其中至少一个是接错的**。两种改法：
104: 
105: - **方案 A（推荐）**：视作 **VCC (12 V) 就地陶瓷去耦**。
106:   按 F4 把干线改到 VCC 后无需挪位，三相各一只 1 µF，正好给自举充电电流提供本地储能。
107: - **方案 B**：视作 **VCC_BUS 高频去耦**（与 C15/C16/C17 电解配对）。
108:   则需把它们分别并到 C15/C16/C17 上（各 `47 µF 电解 + 1 µF 陶瓷`），
109:   而 VCC 干线单独走，不要与之共用。
110: 
111: **不可接受**：留在 SW 节点上（3 µF 接在开关节点，尖峰电流与损耗会直接损坏 XL7005A）。
112: 
113: ---
114: 
115: ## F7 · 补连接器
116: 
117: 当前整张图**没有任何连接器**，A/B/C、VCC_BUS、GND 全靠网络标签。
118: 
119: 建议补：
120: - 电源输入：`VCC_BUS(+) / GND(−)`，大电流端子（≥ 2× 额定电流）
121: - 三相输出：`A / B / C`（U/V/W），大电流端子
122: - 控制接口：6 路 PWM + GND + 逻辑电源（见 F1）
123: - 可选：霍尔/编码器接口、温度传感器
124: 
125: ---
126: 
127: ## F8 · 降压电感 L1（结论：轻载可用，但把 VCC 的带载能力限死在几十 mA）
128: 
129: **已确认的 XL7005A 规格**（用户提供的数据手册参数）：
130: 
131: | 参数 | 值 |
132: |---|---|
133: | 输入电压 | 5 ~ 80 V |
134: | 输出电压 | 1.25 ~ 20 V 可调 |
135: | 最大输出电流 | **0.4 A** |
136: | 开关频率 | **150 kHz 固定** |
137: | 静态电流 Iq | 2.5 mA |
138: | 整流方式 | 非同步（需外置肖特基） |
139: 
140: > 注意：宣传语里的"输入 30 V 以上、1 A 以内"指的是该方案适用的**负载场合**，不是输出能力。**输出上限是 0.4 A。**
141: 
142: ### 1) 实际负载估算
143: 
144: VCC 只驱动 FD6288T 和 6 个栅极：
145: 
146: ```
147: I_load ≈ Iq(FD6288T ≈ 2.5 mA) + 6 × Qg × f_PWM + 反馈分压(≈1.2 mA)
148: ```
149: 
150: | f_PWM | 栅极电流（Qg ≈ 60 nC） | 合计 |
151: |---|---|---|
152: | 20 kHz | ≈ 7 mA | ≈ 11 mA |
153: | 50 kHz | ≈ 18 mA | ≈ 22 mA |
154: | 100 kHz | ≈ 36 mA | ≈ 40 mA |
155: 
156: **属于极轻载（约 10 ~ 40 mA）。**
157: 
158: ### 2) L = 47 µH 时的工作状态
159: 
160: `L × fsw = 47 µH × 150 kHz = 7.05 V`
161: 
162: **CCM 纹波**（仅作参考，实际到不了 CCM）：
163: 
164: | Vin | 占空比 D | ΔI | 进入 CCM 的临界负载 ΔI/2 |
165: |---|---|---|---|
166: | 24 V | 0.503 | 0.85 A | 0.43 A |
167: | 36 V | 0.335 | 1.14 A | 0.57 A |
168: | 48 V | 0.252 | 1.28 A | 0.64 A |
169: | 60 V | 0.201 | 1.37 A | 0.68 A |
170: | 80 V | 0.151 | 1.45 A | 0.73 A |
171: 
172: 临界负载全部 **大于** 芯片的 0.4 A 输出上限 → **全负载范围内永远是 DCM**。
173: 
174: **DCM 峰值电流**（这才是真正要看的数）：
175: 
176: ```
177: I_pk = √( 2 × Io × Vout × (Vin − Vout) / (L × fsw × Vin) )
178: ```
179: 
180: | Vin | Io = 25 mA | Io = 400 mA |
181: |---|---|---|
182: | 24 V | 0.21 A | 0.83 A |
183: | 36 V | 0.24 A | 0.95 A |
184: | 48 V | 0.25 A | **1.01 A** |
185: | 60 V | 0.26 A | 1.05 A |
186: | 80 V | 0.27 A | 1.08 A |
187: 
188: **读法**：
189: - 实际负载 10 ~ 40 mA → 峰值 0.21 ~ 0.27 A，**安全，47 µH 可用**；
190: - 但如果 VCC 被拉到接近 0.4 A → 峰值 0.83 ~ 1.08 A，**大概率撞上内部开关限流**，
191:   输出会掉压/打嗝。也就是说 **47 µH 把 VCC 的可用电流限制在几十至一百多 mA**。
192: 
193: ### 3) 结论与建议
194: 
195: - **方案 A（保持现状，推荐）**：VCC 只给栅极驱动供电，47 µH 保留。
196:   必须在图纸/丝印上注明 **"VCC 负载 ≤ 50 mA，禁止外挂其他负载"**。
197: - **方案 B（想吃满 0.4 A）**：按 CCM + 30% 纹波重选感量
198:   ```
199:   L = Vout × (Vin − Vout) / (ΔI × fsw × Vin) ,  ΔI = 0.12 A
200:   ```
201:   | Vin | 需要 L |
202:   |---|---|
203:   | 24 V | 333 µH |
204:   | 48 V | 502 µH |
205:   | 80 V | 570 µH |
206: 
207:   取最恶劣工况 → 选 **470 µH（折中）或 680 µH**，饱和电流 ≥ 1 A。
208: 
209: > 说明：轻载必然进入 DCM，这**本身不是问题**。要在 25 mA 下保持 CCM 需要约 1.2 mH，不现实，
210: > 所有降压芯片在轻载下都会进入 DCM 或跳周期模式。
211: 
212: ### 4) 顺带确认
213: 
214: - **输入耐压这条解除了**：Vin 5 ~ 80 V，覆盖常见 24/48 V 母线（含泵升）。
215: - **D5（SS110-LTP，100 V）**：若母线接近 80 V，反向电压余量只有 20%，偏紧；
216:   母线 ≤ 48 V 则没问题。母线电压高时建议换 150 ~ 200 V 档肖特基，
217:   或注意高温下肖特基的反向漏电。
218: - **轻载跳周期**：负载极轻时芯片可能跳周期，VCC 纹波变大属正常；
219:   若实测纹波偏大，可以并一只 2.2 kΩ 假负载（约 5.5 mA）稳定它。
220: 
221: ---
222: 
223: ## F9 · 保护
224: 
225: - **过流**：FD6288T 无 ITRIP 输入，三种做法
226:   1. 换用带过流输入的驱动芯片；
227:   2. 加比较器 + 逻辑，过流时把 6 路 PWM 全部拉低（并给 MCU 一个 FAULT）；
228:   3. 至少用 MCU 软件限流 + 母线取样。
229: - **母线**：加 TVS/压敏 + 保险丝；确认母线电容耐压 ≥ 1.5 × 最高母线电压，并核算纹波电流。
230: - **欠压**：VCC 加 UVLO（F2 的 B 方案已顺手解决输入侧）。
231: - **刹车**：若需要能量回馈泄放，增加制动斩波电路。
232: 
233: ---
234: 
235: ## F10 · 补齐高边管的栅源下拉
236: 
237: 高边管的源极是相线（会跟随开关浮动），其下拉电阻必须接在 **G ↔ S**，不能接 G↔GND。
238: 建议 6 只管子都配栅源下拉（10–22 kΩ），低边可放宽到接地形式。
239: 
240: **累计新增/改动电阻**：R7/R8/R9 改接 + 新增 3 只（R12/R13/R14）。
241: 
242: ---
243: 
244: ## F11 · 布局要点（PCB 阶段）
245: 
246: 1. 高 di/dt 回路最小：`母线电容 → 高边 D → 高边 S → 相线 → 低边 D → 低边 S → GND → 回母线电容`。
247: 2. 母线陶瓷电容尽量贴高边管漏极；电解可以稍远。
248: 3. U1 的 VCC 去耦（C1 1 µF）紧贴 U1 的 7 脚；U2 的 VIN 就近加 1 µF + 100 nF。
249: 4. 自举电容 C5/C6/C7 尽量贴 U1 的 VB/VS 引脚，回路最短。
250: 5. 栅极驱动走线（10 Ω 电阻到栅极）要短；栅极回流的源极线单独走，在星点汇合。
251: 6. SW 节点铺铜面积尽量小（散热与辐射的折中），禁止作为跳线使用。
252: 7. 强电与弱电（PWM、模拟采样）分区，间距满足爬电要求。
253: 
254: ---
255: 
256: ## F12 · 与控制板（主控 MCU）的接口要求
257: 
258: 系统链路：`主控 → 6 路 PWM → 本板 FD6288T → 6×MOSFET → 电机`。
259: 链路本身是标准做法，但两板之间的接口必须满足下列条件。
260: 
261: ### 1) 连接器与下拉（对应 F1，走线变长后更关键）
262: 
263: - 6 路 PWM + GND 走**同一个连接器**，不要分散；
264: - 驱动板每路输入的 **10 kΩ 下拉必须有** —— 主控复位 / 程序未跑 / 排线松脱时，
265:   驱动器输入被强制为低，避免上下桥直通炸管。
266: 
267: ### 2) 线缆与地回路
268: 
269: - **每 2 根信号夹 1 根地**（或直接用地线包裹信号），不要只拉一根细地线；
270: - 长度尽量 ≤ 20 ~ 30 cm；更长时在**接收端（驱动板）串 100 Ω** 抑制振铃与过冲；
271: - **两块板必须共地**，但**不能随便连**：驱动板的地是功率地（电机电流流过），
272:   主控板是数字地。建议在**单点（星点）**连接，必要时串磁珠或共模电感，
273:   否则开关噪声会灌进主控导致复位/ADC 异常。
274: 
275: ### 3) 逻辑电平
276: 
277: - 确认主控 IO 电平（3.3 V / 5 V）满足 FD6288T 的 VIH；
278: - 若主控为 3.3 V 而驱动器需 5 V 逻辑，需加电平转换（或用 5 V 主控）。
279: 
280: ### 4) 死区与换相时序
281: 
282: - **绝不能同时给 HINn 与 LINn 高电平**；
283: - FD6288T 内部有死区，但主控仍应输出互补 PWM（优先使用主控的三相 PWM 模块，
284:   它自带死区插入）。软件生成的 PWM 必须显式插入死区（通常 200 ns ~ 1 µs）。
285: 
286: ### 5) ⚠️ 自举供电的占空比上限（易被忽略，会导致高边管烧毁）
287: 
288: 高边驱动靠自举电容 C5/C6/C7 供电，**必须靠低边周期性导通来充电**。
289: 
290: - 软件必须限制**最大占空比 ≤ 95 % ~ 98 %**，或保证每个 PWM 周期低边至少导通 **1 ~ 2 µs**；
291: - 若长时间接近 100 % 占空比，自举电容亏电 → 高边栅压下降 → 高边管进入线性区 →
292:   迅速发热损坏；
293: - 若应用确实需要 100 % 占空比，必须改用**电荷泵或独立隔离电源**给 VB 供电。
294: 
295: ### 6) ⚠️ 反馈通道缺失（架构性缺口）
296: 
297: 本板目前**只能执行、不能反馈**：
298: 
299: | 控制方式 | 需要本板提供 | 现状 |
300: |---|---|---|
301: | 方波六步换相（有霍尔） | 霍尔信号接主控 | 本板不参与，但需引出霍尔接口 |
302: | 方波六步换相（无感，反电动势过零） | 相电压分压到主控 ADC | **无分压网络** |
303: | 无感 FOC | 至少两相电流采样 + 相电压采样 | **无采样电阻、无运放、无分压** |
304: 
305: 若主控要做无感 FOC，本板需增加：低边分流电阻（或相电流霍尔）、电流放大器、
306: 相电压分压网络，并把信号引到主控 ADC。这是比 F1~F4 更根本的设计缺口。
307: 
308: ### 7) 上电 / 复位时序
309: 
310: 1. 先上 `VCC_BUS`，等 `VCC ≈ 12 V` 稳定；
311: 2. 主控完成初始化、GPIO 配置为输出后再开始发 PWM；
312: 3. 建议主控留一个 GPIO 作为"驱动使能"，或至少保证 PWM 初始化完成前不输出；
313: 4. 故障时先把 PWM 全部拉低，再切断母线。
314: 
315: ### 8) 需向主控厂商/数据手册确认的三件事
316: 
317: 1. IO 电平（3.3 V / 5 V）；
318: 2. 是否有**带死区的三相 PWM 模块**；
319: 3. 采用方波换相还是 FOC，是否需要电流/电压反馈。
320: 
321: 1. **静态**：万用表逐点核对 —— 低边源极对地 0 Ω；EN 对地不为 0；SW 对 VCC/GND 无直流短路。
322: 2. **空载上电**（母线用小电压、限流电源）：量 VCC ≈ 12.1 V，量 VBn–VSn ≈ 11.3 V。
323: 3. **不接电机、给 PWM**：示波器看 HO/LO 波形、死区、栅极上升/下降时间。
324: 4. **接电机、低占空比**：看相电流、SW 振铃、MOSFET 温升。
325: 5. **满载/堵转**：验证过流保护动作点与温升。

lines.text: # motor-driver V1.0 原理图整改清单
> 配套文件：`分析报告.md`（问题定位与证据）
> 图框信息：原理图 Schematic1 / 板子 Board1 / 1 页共 1 页 / V1.0 A3
## 修改项一览
| 编号 | 位置 | 动作 | 优先级 |
| F1 | U1 脚 1–6 | 引出 6 路 PWM 到连接器，并加 10 kΩ 下拉 | P0 |
| F2 | U2 脚 4 (EN) | 断开与 GND/COM 的连接，改接 VIN 或加 UVLO 分压 | P0 |
| F3 | Q1/Q5/Q4 源极 | 源极直接接功率地；R7/R8/R9 改作栅源下拉 | P0 |
| F4 | 右侧 x≈773.6 干线 | 从 SW 侧改接到 L1 之后的 VCC 节点 | P0 |
| F5 | D1–D3 阳极 | 必须取自 VCC (12 V)，不得取自 SW 或 VCC_BUS | P0 |
| F6 | C8–C10 | 明确用途后归位（VCC 就近去耦 或 母线陶瓷） | P1 |
| F7 | 全板 | 加电源/三相/PWM 连接器 | P1 |
| F8 | L1 | 确认 fsw 与输入耐压（47 µH 本身可用） | P2 |
| F9 | 保护 | 过流、母线 TVS、UVLO | P1 |
| F10 | 高边管 | 补 3 只栅源下拉 | P2 |
| F11 | 布局 | 高频回路最小化、就近去耦、开尔文地 | P2 |
## F1 · U1 的 6 路 PWM 输入悬空
1. HIN1(1)/HIN2(2)/HIN3(3)、LIN1(4)/LIN2(5)/LIN3(6) 各拉一条线到新增连接器。
2. 每根输入线在驱动器一侧加 **10 kΩ 下拉到 GND**（防止悬空直通）。
3. 若走线较长或与功率线并行，串 **100 Ω**（紧靠驱动器引脚）。
**连接器建议**：2.54 mm 1×8 排针 / JST-GH，定义为
`PWM1H, PWM1L, PWM2H, PWM2L, PWM3H, PWM3L, GND, 逻辑电源`
**验证**：断开 MCU 后，用示波器看 6 个引脚应为低电平；6 路输入全低时 HO/LO 应为低。
## F2 · U2 (XL7005A) 的 EN 接地
**根因**：EN 与 U2 的 GND(5–8)、U1 的 COM(8) 在同一个网络（= GND）。
**动作（三选一）**
- **A（最小改动）**：删除 EN→GND 的连线，把 EN 直接接到 VIN(1)。
- **B（推荐，带 UVLO）**：EN 经分压接 VCC_BUS
- 目标：母线约 18 V 才启动
- `R_up = 130 kΩ`（VCC_BUS → EN），`R_dn = 10 kΩ`（EN → GND）
- EN 到 GND 再并 `100 nF` 滤波
- 实测阈值 = V_EN(th) × (R_up+R_dn)/R_dn ≈ 1.25 V × 14 ≈ **17.5 V**
- **C**：由 MCU 的一个 GPIO 控制 EN（可做软启动/故障关断）。
**必做前置检查**：核对 XL7005A 数据手册，确认 **4 脚确实是 EN 且高电平有效**。若是低有效或内部上拉，则接法完全不同。
## F3 · 三个低边管源极只经 20 kΩ 到地
**根因**：Q1/Q5/Q4 的源极节点唯一的对外连接是 R7/R8/R9（20 kΩ）→ GND，没有源极直连。
1. **每个低边管的源极节点直接连到功率地**（铺铜 + 多过孔，不要细线）。
2. 改完后 R7/R8/R9 变成 GND↔GND，失去作用 —— 把它们**改接到栅极**：
3. 三个低边源极应汇聚到**同一个星点**，再把该星点单点连到 U1 的 COM(8) 和 U2 的 GND，避免栅极驱动回流串入功率地。
4. 若后续要做电流采样：星点与功率地之间插入分流电阻，采样走差分开尔文线。
**验证**：断电用万用表量 Q1.S–Q5.S–Q4.S 之间应为 0 Ω；上电后电机可正常转动。
## F4 · SW 开关节点被引到图纸右侧干线
2. 让右侧干线改从 **L1 之后的 VCC 节点**取电（即 L1 上端 / C11 / C12 / R10 上端 / U1.VCC 那一网络）。
3. 改完后 SW 网络只允许包含三样东西：`U2.SW(2)`、`L1` 下端、`D5` 阴极。
4. SW 回路在 PCB 上必须**极短、极粗**：`U2.SW → L1 → D5 → C11 地` 围成的面积最小化，禁止跨越其他区域。
**验证**：用欧姆档量 SW 节点对 VCC 节点应为 L1 的直流电阻（≈0 Ω 但经电感），对 GND 不应有电容通路；上电后用示波器看 SW 波形应是干净方波，无异常振铃过冲。
## F5 · 自举二极管阳极供电
**原则**：D1/D2/D3 的**阳极必须接 VCC (12 V)**，阴极经自举电容接到 VB1/VB2/VB3。
绝不能接 SW（开关节点）或 VCC_BUS（母线）—— 后者会把母线电压加在 VB–VS 之间，直接打坏驱动器。
1. 确认 F4 修改后，右侧干线就是 VCC (12 V)。
2. 逐相确认：`D1.A → VCC`，`D1.K → VB1(20) 且 C5 → VB1↔VS1`；D2/D3 同理。
**验证**：上电且未换相时，量 VB1–VS1、VB2–VS2、VB3–VS3 均应为 ≈ 11.3 V（VCC 减去二极管压降）。
## F6 · C8/C9/C10 的归属（必须先定用途）
这三只 1 µF 现在和 D1–D3 阳极同挂在右侧干线上，说明**其中至少一个是接错的**。两种改法：
- **方案 A（推荐）**：视作 **VCC (12 V) 就地陶瓷去耦**。
按 F4 把干线改到 VCC 后无需挪位，三相各一只 1 µF，正好给自举充电电流提供本地储能。
- **方案 B**：视作 **VCC_BUS 高频去耦**（与 C15/C16/C17 电解配对）。
则需把它们分别并到 C15/C16/C17 上（各 `47 µF 电解 + 1 µF 陶瓷`），
而 VCC 干线单独走，不要与之共用。
**不可接受**：留在 SW 节点上（3 µF 接在开关节点，尖峰电流与损耗会直接损坏 XL7005A）。
## F7 · 补连接器
当前整张图**没有任何连接器**，A/B/C、VCC_BUS、GND 全靠网络标签。
建议补：
- 电源输入：`VCC_BUS(+) / GND(−)`，大电流端子（≥ 2× 额定电流）
- 三相输出：`A / B / C`（U/V/W），大电流端子
- 控制接口：6 路 PWM + GND + 逻辑电源（见 F1）
- 可选：霍尔/编码器接口、温度传感器
## F8 · 降压电感 L1（结论：轻载可用，但把 VCC 的带载能力限死在几十 mA）
**已确认的 XL7005A 规格**（用户提供的数据手册参数）：
| 参数 | 值 |
| 输入电压 | 5 ~ 80 V |
| 输出电压 | 1.25 ~ 20 V 可调 |
| 最大输出电流 | **0.4 A** |
| 开关频率 | **150 kHz 固定** |
| 静态电流 Iq | 2.5 mA |
| 整流方式 | 非同步（需外置肖特基） |
> 注意：宣传语里的"输入 30 V 以上、1 A 以内"指的是该方案适用的**负载场合**，不是输出能力。**输出上限是 0.4 A。**
### 1) 实际负载估算
VCC 只驱动 FD6288T 和 6 个栅极：
I_load ≈ Iq(FD6288T ≈ 2.5 mA) + 6 × Qg × f_PWM + 反馈分压(≈1.2 mA)
| f_PWM | 栅极电流（Qg ≈ 60 nC） | 合计 |
**属于极轻载（约 10 ~ 40 mA）。**
### 2) L = 47 µH 时的工作状态
`L × fsw = 47 µH × 150 kHz = 7.05 V`
**CCM 纹波**（仅作参考，实际到不了 CCM）：
| Vin | 占空比 D | ΔI | 进入 CCM 的临界负载 ΔI/2 |
临界负载全部 **大于** 芯片的 0.4 A 输出上限 → **全负载范围内永远是 DCM**。
**DCM 峰值电流**（这才是真正要看的数）：
I_pk = √( 2 × Io × Vout × (Vin − Vout) / (L × fsw × Vin) )
| Vin | Io = 25 mA | Io = 400 mA |
- 但如果 VCC 被拉到接近 0.4 A → 峰值 0.83 ~ 1.08 A，**大概率撞上内部开关限流**，
输出会掉压/打嗝。也就是说 **47 µH 把 VCC 的可用电流限制在几十至一百多 mA**。
### 3) 结论与建议
- **方案 A（保持现状，推荐）**：VCC 只给栅极驱动供电，47 µH 保留。
必须在图纸/丝印上注明 **"VCC 负载 ≤ 50 mA，禁止外挂其他负载"**。
- **方案 B（想吃满 0.4 A）**：按 CCM + 30% 纹波重选感量
L = Vout × (Vin − Vout) / (ΔI × fsw × Vin) ,  ΔI = 0.12 A
| Vin | 需要 L |
取最恶劣工况 → 选 **470 µH（折中）或 680 µH**，饱和电流 ≥ 1 A。
> 说明：轻载必然进入 DCM，这**本身不是问题**。要在 25 mA 下保持 CCM 需要约 1.2 mH，不现实，
> 所有降压芯片在轻载下都会进入 DCM 或跳周期模式。
### 4) 顺带确认
- **输入耐压这条解除了**：Vin 5 ~ 80 V，覆盖常见 24/48 V 母线（含泵升）。
- **D5（SS110-LTP，100 V）**：若母线接近 80 V，反向电压余量只有 20%，偏紧；
母线 ≤ 48 V 则没问题。母线电压高时建议换 150 ~ 200 V 档肖特基，
或注意高温下肖特基的反向漏电。
- **轻载跳周期**：负载极轻时芯片可能跳周期，VCC 纹波变大属正常；
若实测纹波偏大，可以并一只 2.2 kΩ 假负载（约 5.5 mA）稳定它。
## F9 · 保护
- **过流**：FD6288T 无 ITRIP 输入，三种做法
1. 换用带过流输入的驱动芯片；
2. 加比较器 + 逻辑，过流时把 6 路 PWM 全部拉低（并给 MCU 一个 FAULT）；
3. 至少用 MCU 软件限流 + 母线取样。
- **母线**：加 TVS/压敏 + 保险丝；确认母线电容耐压 ≥ 1.5 × 最高母线电压，并核算纹波电流。
- **欠压**：VCC 加 UVLO（F2 的 B 方案已顺手解决输入侧）。
- **刹车**：若需要能量回馈泄放，增加制动斩波电路。
## F10 · 补齐高边管的栅源下拉
高边管的源极是相线（会跟随开关浮动），其下拉电阻必须接在 **G ↔ S**，不能接 G↔GND。
建议 6 只管子都配栅源下拉（10–22 kΩ），低边可放宽到接地形式。
**累计新增/改动电阻**：R7/R8/R9 改接 + 新增 3 只（R12/R13/R14）。
## F11 · 布局要点（PCB 阶段）
1. 高 di/dt 回路最小：`母线电容 → 高边 D → 高边 S → 相线 → 低边 D → 低边 S → GND → 回母线电容`。
2. 母线陶瓷电容尽量贴高边管漏极；电解可以稍远。
3. U1 的 VCC 去耦（C1 1 µF）紧贴 U1 的 7 脚；U2 的 VIN 就近加 1 µF + 100 nF。
4. 自举电容 C5/C6/C7 尽量贴 U1 的 VB/VS 引脚，回路最短。
5. 栅极驱动走线（10 Ω 电阻到栅极）要短；栅极回流的源极线单独走，在星点汇合。
6. SW 节点铺铜面积尽量小（散热与辐射的折中），禁止作为跳线使用。
7. 强电与弱电（PWM、模拟采样）分区，间距满足爬电要求。
## F12 · 与控制板（主控 MCU）的接口要求
系统链路：`主控 → 6 路 PWM → 本板 FD6288T → 6×MOSFET → 电机`。
链路本身是标准做法，但两板之间的接口必须满足下列条件。
### 1) 连接器与下拉（对应 F1，走线变长后更关键）
- 6 路 PWM + GND 走**同一个连接器**，不要分散；
- 驱动板每路输入的 **10 kΩ 下拉必须有** —— 主控复位 / 程序未跑 / 排线松脱时，
驱动器输入被强制为低，避免上下桥直通炸管。
### 2) 线缆与地回路
- **每 2 根信号夹 1 根地**（或直接用地线包裹信号），不要只拉一根细地线；
- 长度尽量 ≤ 20 ~ 30 cm；更长时在**接收端（驱动板）串 100 Ω** 抑制振铃与过冲；
- **两块板必须共地**，但**不能随便连**：驱动板的地是功率地（电机电流流过），
主控板是数字地。建议在**单点（星点）**连接，必要时串磁珠或共模电感，
否则开关噪声会灌进主控导致复位/ADC 异常。
### 3) 逻辑电平
- 确认主控 IO 电平（3.3 V / 5 V）满足 FD6288T 的 VIH；
- 若主控为 3.3 V 而驱动器需 5 V 逻辑，需加电平转换（或用 5 V 主控）。
### 4) 死区与换相时序
- **绝不能同时给 HINn 与 LINn 高电平**；
- FD6288T 内部有死区，但主控仍应输出互补 PWM（优先使用主控的三相 PWM 模块，
它自带死区插入）。软件生成的 PWM 必须显式插入死区（通常 200 ns ~ 1 µs）。
### 5) ⚠️ 自举供电的占空比上限（易被忽略，会导致高边管烧毁）
高边驱动靠自举电容 C5/C6/C7 供电，**必须靠低边周期性导通来充电**。
- 软件必须限制**最大占空比 ≤ 95 % ~ 98 %**，或保证每个 PWM 周期低边至少导通 **1 ~ 2 µs**；
- 若长时间接近 100 % 占空比，自举电容亏电 → 高边栅压下降 → 高边管进入线性区 →
迅速发热损坏；
- 若应用确实需要 100 % 占空比，必须改用**电荷泵或独立隔离电源**给 VB 供电。
### 6) ⚠️ 反馈通道缺失（架构性缺口）
本板目前**只能执行、不能反馈**：
| 控制方式 | 需要本板提供 | 现状 |
| 方波六步换相（有霍尔） | 霍尔信号接主控 | 本板不参与，但需引出霍尔接口 |
| 方波六步换相（无感，反电动势过零） | 相电压分压到主控 ADC | **无分压网络** |
| 无感 FOC | 至少两相电流采样 + 相电压采样 | **无采样电阻、无运放、无分压** |
若主控要做无感 FOC，本板需增加：低边分流电阻（或相电流霍尔）、电流放大器、
相电压分压网络，并把信号引到主控 ADC。这是比 F1~F4 更根本的设计缺口。
### 7) 上电 / 复位时序
1. 先上 `VCC_BUS`，等 `VCC ≈ 12 V` 稳定；
2. 主控完成初始化、GPIO 配置为输出后再开始发 PWM；
3. 建议主控留一个 GPIO 作为"驱动使能"，或至少保证 PWM 初始化完成前不输出；
4. 故障时先把 PWM 全部拉低，再切断母线。
### 8) 需向主控厂商/数据手册确认的三件事
2. 是否有**带死区的三相 PWM 模块**；
3. 采用方波换相还是 FOC，是否需要电流/电压反馈。
1. **静态**：万用表逐点核对 —— 低边源极对地 0 Ω；EN 对地不为 0；SW 对 VCC/GND 无直流短路。
2. **空载上电**（母线用小电压、限流电源）：量 VCC ≈ 12.1 V，量 VBn–VSn ≈ 11.3 V。
3. **不接电机、给 PWM**：示波器看 HO/LO 波形、死区、栅极上升/下降时间。
4. **接电机、低占空比**：看相电流、SW 振铃、MOSFET 温升。
5. **满载/堵转**：验证过流保护动作点与温升。

So the user is asking: without phase voltage sensing, can I not determine rotor position?

Answer: Yes, essentially correct. For sensorless six-step (trapezoidal) commutation, rotor position is determined by **back-EMF zero-crossing detection (BEMF ZCD)** on the floating phase. That requires measuring the phase voltage of the non-energized (floating) phase. The driver board currently has:

So yes — the MCU cannot see the back-EMF, therefore cannot detect zero crossings, therefore cannot know when to commutate. The motor won't start or run properly.

Let me be precise and thorough about what's needed:

### What sensorless six-step needs

In six-step (trapezoidal) drive, at any moment two phases are energized and one is floating. The back-EMF of the floating phase crosses zero at the midpoint between commutation points — specifically, the zero crossing of the floating phase's back-EMF occurs 30 electrical degrees after the commutation instant. So:
- Detect ZC on the floating phase
- Wait 30° (a timer delay based on the last commutation period)
- Commutate

So you need:
1. **Access to the three phase voltages** (relative to a virtual neutral or with a resistor network).
2. A comparator or ADC to detect the zero crossing.
3. Also, at low speed/standstill back-EMF is zero → cannot detect position → need a **startup strategy** (align + ramp/open-loop acceleration until BEMF is large enough).

### Circuit needed (standard approach)

**Option A: three resistor dividers + ADC**
- From each phase (A/B/C) to GND: R_top (e.g., 100k) + R_bottom (e.g., 10k or 4.7k)
- Also a "virtual neutral" from three equal resistors (e.g., 100k each) from A/B/C to a common node
- Then either:
  - MCU ADC samples each phase and virtual neutral, computes the difference in software, or
  - Use internal comparator/analog comparator
- Scaling: the divider must bring Vbus (up to 48V or so) down to ≤ ADC Vref (3.3V). With Vbus up to 60V: 60V × (Rb/(Rt+Rb)) ≤ 3.3V → ratio ≤ 0.055 → e.g., Rt = 180k, Rb = 10k → ratio 0.0526 → 60V → 3.16V. OK. Use 1% resistors and a small capacitor (e.g., 1nF) to filter PWM noise.
- **Important**: the divider must be fast enough — but the phase voltage has PWM content. Standard practice: RC filter with time constant ~ a few µs to a few tens of µs, low enough to reject PWM but fast enough to track the BEMF at max electrical f

block.text:
Excellent! The SVD confirms:
- **VC0, VC1, VC2** — three voltage comparators (VC0, VC1, VC2 with VC2_CR, VC2_INTF etc.). That's 3 comparators! 
- **OPA** (OP0OEN1..OP4BUFEN → OPA0..OPA3?) 
- **ADC** with CH0MUX..CH15MUX (16 channels), SQR/JQR (sequence + injected queue)
- **TIM6** (ADTIM6), TIM0-TIM6 timers
- **GPIO PA/PB/PC/PD/PE/PF** with PA00_SEL..PF11_SEL (function mux)

So HC32F072 has 3 built-in voltage comparators (VC0, VC1, VC2) — perfect for 3-phase BEMF zero-crossing detection! And ADC 16 channels. And OPA (probably 4: OP0-OP3, with OP3BUFEN/OP4BUFEN... hmm).

Wait — actually HC32F072: "VC0/VC1/VC2" = 3 comparators. Let me verify by looking at the SVD more closely — get VC peripheral description and OPA description, and ADC.

Also need the LQFP48 pinout to know which pins are available in the JATA (LQFP48) package. The .h file may have package info. Actually pin assignment for LQFP48 needs the datasheet pin table.

Hmm. Important consideration: the deliverable is a schematic of the **driver board** (power board with FD6288T + MOSFETs), updated to add:
1. BEMF sensing network (3 dividers + virtual neutral)
2. Zero-crossing detection (comparators — either the MCU's internal VC or external LM339)
3. Connectors to MCU
4. All the F1-F12 fixes

Does the schematic need to include the MCU itself? The user said "根据我之前现有的原理图更正一份带有相电压采集的可以判断电机转动角度的原理图" — correct the existing schematic to include phase voltage sensing. So the driver board schematic. But the user now says "最后遵守电路设计准则设计一份合格的工程原理图" — design a qualified engineering schematic.

The original board has no MCU. The driver board only has FD6288T + MOSFETs + XL7005A. So the BEMF sensing network would be on the driver board, with signals going to a connector to the HC32F072 control board.

But wait — the user might want a single-board design including the MCU. Hmm. This is exactly a Phase 2 question to ask!

Per workflow Phase 2, I must ask:
1. 实现路径与协议 — 过零检测用 MCU 内置 VC 比较器 / 外部 LM339 / ADC 软件比较? 单板集成 MCU 还是保持驱动板+控制板两块?
2. 开发环境与工具链 — EDA: 嘉立创EDA / KiCad? 
3. 三方库或框架依赖 — MCU 固件是否需要 (DDL 库)?

Let me gather a bit more chip info first (Phase 1) to make the questions well-grounded, then ask.

Let me check:
- VC peripheral details from SVD (VC0_CR, VC0_FILTER, VC0_HYS_SEL, VC0_OUT_CFG, VC0_INTF) — good, there's a filter and hysteresis and output config.
- OPA details
- ADC channels
- The .h file for VC/OPA register base addresses
- LQFP48 pin list — need datasheet. Let me check if the ds_* files have anything, or check HC32F072.h for pin definitions.

Let me look at the SVD for VC and OPA peripheral descriptions, and check the header for pin mappings.

Actually, an important question: does the HC32F072 LQFP48 package even expose 3 VC inputs and the needed ADC pins? Let me check the header for VC0_IN/VC1_IN/VC2_IN pin assignments.

Let me grep the SVD for VC0_IN and the .h for pin mux.

Let me do targeted greps.
The SVD confirms **VC0/VC1/VC2 — three on-chip voltage comparators**, plus ADC (16 ch) and TIM6. Let me extract the details needed for the design.

This is GOLD. `vc.h` gives exact VC configuration:

- **3 comparators** (VC0, VC1, VC2) ✓
- Each VC has a **P input** (positive) and **N input** (negative), each selectable from a mux of GPIO pins!
  - VC0 P: PC0/PC1/PC2/PC3/PA0/PA1/PA2/PA3/PA4/PA5/PA6/PA7/PB4/PB5/PB6/DAC0
  - VC0 N: PA0/PA1/PA2/PA3/PA4/PA5/PA6/PA7/PC4/PC5/DAC0/**ResDivOut**/**AiTs**/**AiBg1p2**/**AiAdcVref**/**AiLdo**
  - VC1 P: PA0/PA1/PA2/PA3/PA4/PA5/PB1/PB2/PB10/PB12/PB13/PB14/PB4/DAC0/PB6/PB7
  - VC1 N: PC0/PC1/PC2/PC3/PA0/PA1/PB0/PB1/PB2/PB3/DAC1/**ResDivOut**/...
  - VC2 P: PA5/PB1/PE9/PE10/PE11/PE13/PE14/PE15/PB11/PB14/PD9/PD10/PD11/PC7/DAC0
  - VC2 N: PA5/PB1/PE11/PE15/PB11/PB14/PD10/PD11/PC7/DAC0
- **VC N 端有 `ResDivOut`（电阻分压）和 `AiBg1p2`（内部 1.2V 基准）** — CRITICAL! The N input can be the internal **ResDivOut** (internal resistor divider output) or internal 1.2V reference. This is huge: it means VC can compare a phase-divided input against an internally generated reference.
- **VC output routing**: 
  - `VcOutTIM4`/`VcOutTIM5`/`VcOutTIM6` = **结果输出到Timer4/5/6捕获输入CHX使能** → the VC output can DIRECTLY trigger a timer capture input! That's exactly what you want for high-precision zero-crossing timestamps.
  - `VcOutInvTIM4/5/6` = 反向使能
  - `VcOutBrake` = 结果作为Advanced Timer刹车控制 → hardware over-current trip!
  - `VcOutTIM0RCLR..TIM3RCLR`, `VcOutTIMBK`
- **VC has programmable hysteresis** 10/20/30mV, **output filter** 7µs..28.8ms, **bias current** selection (300nA..20µA)
- **VC has an internal DAC** (Vc_DacInit) with 6-bit divider (u8DivVal 0-63) → programmable threshold reference! 
  - `bDivEn`, `u8DivVal` (0-63), `enDivVref` (AVCC or ADC SREF reference)
  - So VC0's N input can use the internal divider as a programmable threshold — this is a "VC DAC".

So the HC32F072's VC comparators are PERFECT for sensorless BEMF zero-crossing:
- Route each phase's divided voltage to VCx P input
- Route the virtual neutral to VCx N input
- Or better: use one VC per phase with the internal ResDivOut/1.2V ref... 

Hmm, actually the classic HC32 approach: the internal "电阻分压 ResDivOut" is for measuring VBAT. Let me not over-assume.

Key architecture decision for zero-crossing detection on HC32F072:
Option 1 (3 comparators, virtual neutral): 
- Virtual neutral node (3× equal R from U/V/W) → divided? No — virtual neutral must be scaled the same as phase.
- Actually: phase divider (Rtop/Rbot) gives Vphase×k. Virtual neutral from 3 equal resistors also needs ×k. Simplest: build the virtual neutral from the *tops* of three equal divider resistors is wrong; instead use 3 equal resistors from the three divided nodes to a common node → that gives k×(Va+Vb+Vc)/3 = k×Vneutral. Yes! Three equal resistors from the three divided phase nodes to a common node gives the divided virtual neutral. 
- Then VC0: P = divided phase A, N = divided virtual neutral. VC1: P = divided B, N = divided VN. VC2: P = divided C, N = divided VN.
- But we need 3 comparators with independent pin inputs — available.

Wait, but there's a mux conflict: can VC0_P be PA0 and VC1_N be PA0? No, same pin. Need to pick distinct pins.

Let me now note the constraint: VC0_P options and VC0_N options, VC1_P/N, VC2_P/N.

For a clean design:
- VC0_P = PA0, VC0_N = PA1  (phases A and VN)
- VC1_P = PA2, VC1_N = PA3  (phases B and VN) — VC1_N includes PA1? VC1_N: PC0,PC1,PC2,PC3,PA0,PA1,PB0,PB1,PB2,PB3,DAC1,ResDivOut,... so VC1_N can be PA1! 
  Hmm but PA1 as VC1_N and VC0_N both — VC0_N includes PA1. If both VC0_N and VC1_N select PA1 that's fine? They'd both compare against VN. But the mux might not allow the same pin to feed two comparators... Actually the pin would be routed to both. Risky.
  
Better: use distinct pins:
- VC0_P = PA0 (phase A), VC0_N = PA1 (VN)
- VC1_P = PA2 (phase B), VC1_N = PA3 (VN)  → VC1_N can be PA0,PA1,PB0,PB1,PB2,PB3,PC0-3,DAC1,ResDivOut. Hmm PA3 is not in VC1_N list! VC1_N: 输入通道0 PC0, 1 PC1, 2 PC2, 3 PC3, 4 PA0, 5 PA1, 6 PB0, 7 PB1, 8 PB2, 9 PB3, 10 DAC1, 11 ResDivOut, 12 AiTs, 13 AiBg1p2, 14 AiAdcVref, 15 AiLdo.
  So VC1_N ∈ {PC0..PC3, PA0, PA1, PB0..PB3, DAC1, ResDivOut, ...}
  And VC1_P ∈ {PA0..PA5, PB1, PB2, PB10, PB12, PB13, PB14, PB4, DAC0, PB6, PB7}
  
  So VC1_P and VC1_N: pick VC1_P = PA4, VC1_N = PA0? Both PA0... VC1_N=PA0 and VC0_P=PA0 conflict.
  
  Let me choose:
  - VC0_P = PA0 (phase A sense), VC0_N = PA1 (VN)
  - VC1_P = PA2 (phase B sense), VC1_N = PB0 (VN)
  - VC2_P = PB1 (phase C sense), VC2_N = PB11? VC2_N ∈ {PA5, PB1, PE11, PE15, PB11, PB14, PD10, PD11, PC7, DAC0}. VC2_P ∈ {PA5, PB1, PE9..PE15, PB11, PB14, PD9..PD11, PC7, DAC0}. So VC2_P=PB1 conflicts with VC2_N=PB11? No, they're different pins. VC2_P = PB1, VC2_N = PB11. Fine.
  
  But wait, VN should be one single node feeding all three N inputs. If VC0_N=PA1, VC1_N=PB0, VC2_N=PB11 — all three pins tie to the same VN net. That's fine electrically (same node, three pins).

content.text: Background subagent 73ea3bb3-e73b-416e-bf2e-ddc2fc2dc9a2 reported:

## 绝对路径

`C:\Users\limer\Desktop\motor-drive\Soft\HC32F072JATA.md`（386 行，35 KB，UTF-8，中文 Markdown）

内容覆盖要求的 1–9 节，外加明确标注的 **§10 未确认/待核对（16 项表格）**，正文另以 `⚠️未确认` 就地标记。每条事实均带 `文件:行号 + 符号名` 引用。全部结论仅来自指定的本地 DDL 工程，未使用网络。

## 15 行要点总结

1. **（a）比较器数量 = 3 个：VC0 / VC1 / VC2**（`drivers/inc/vc.h:49` `en_vc_channel_t`），三通道均有中断（`interrupts_hc32f072.h` `INT_CALLBACK_VC0/1/2`）。
2. **VC 负端没有任何 GPIO 外部输入**——N 端只有 16 档（`N_SEL:4`），除 GPIO 正端外全是内部温度/1.2V/VREF/LDO/电阻分压/DAC0/DAC1。做零交叉时必须用内部基准或 DAC 当阈值，这是最关键的架构约束。
3. 每通道可编程项齐全：迟滞 0/10/20/30 mV、偏置电流 300 nA~20 µA、输出滤波 7 µs~28.8 ms（8 档）、DAC 分压 0–63 档、上升/下降/高电平中断。
4. **（b）VC → ADC：能**，但只能经 `AdcMskTrigVC0`(bit11) / `AdcMskTrigVC1`(bit12) 作为 ADC 外部触发源（写 `ADC_EXTTRIGGER0/1`）；**VC2 不在 ADC 触发源内**。
5. **（b）VC → 定时器：能**。① 直连捕获：`VcOutTIM4/5/6` = "结果输出到 Timer4/5/6 捕获输入 CHX 使能" → **可硬件打零交叉时间戳**；② 直连清计数 `VcOutTIM0RCLR…TIM3RCLR`；③ 刹车 `VcOutTIMBK`/`VcOutBrake`。
6. 定时器侧印证了这条互连：`timer3.h:299` `Tim3OC_Ref_Clr = 0 /* 来自VC的OC_Ref_Clr */` + `bVCClrEn`、`bEnVCBrake`（`timer3.h`/`bt.h` 同款）。
7. **VC → TIM0/1/2/3 捕获：不能**（只能清计数/刹车/反向）；TIM3 捕获必须走引脚（`Gpio_SfTimCCfg`）。
8. **VC → GPIO 引脚：不能**（`en_vc_output_cfg_t` 与 GPIO SF 枚举均无此项）。
9. **AOS：本器件没有独立 AOS 外设驱动**（无 `aos.h`/`aos.c`），AOS 由 ADTIM 内部 `AOSSR/AOSCL/ITRIG` 实现；`ITRIG.IAOS0S~IAOS3S` 的 16 个源中 `10=VC0_INT`、`11=VC1_INT`（**无 VC2**），可驱动 `AdtHwTrigAos0..3` → `Adt_CfgHwCaptureA/B()`。
10. **（c）ADTIM6 不是三相六路**：单颗 ADT 只有 `AdtCHxA` / `AdtCHxB` 两个通道，死区寄存器仅一组 `DTUAR/DTDAR` → **1 组互补对**。三相需 **ADTIM4+5+6 三颗同步**（`stc_adt_sw_sync_t{bAdTim4,bAdTim5,bAdTim6}` + `Adt_SwSyncStart()`）。
11. ADT 支持：中心对齐（`AdtTriangleModeA/B`）、16 位死区（`Adt_SetDTUA/DTDA`，复位 0xFFFF）、16 路端口刹车 + 同高/同低刹车 + 软件刹车、PWM 展频。**载波（Chopper）本地查不到**（grep `载波|Carrier|Chop` 零命中）。
12. **GPIO 复用机制**：每脚一个 `PXnn_SEL` 寄存器写 0–7；API 是 **`Gpio_SetAfMode(port, pin, af)` + `Gpio_SetAnalogMode()`**——**本 DDL 不存在 `GPIO_SetFunc`**（按其它 HC32 系列写法会编译不过）。
13. **（d）LQFP48 引脚编号在本地完全不存在**：无 pin table、无 pinout、无 `*_pin.h`；`board_evbhc32lf07x.h` 只给 EVB 的"端口+位号"（XTHI=PF0/XTHO=PF1、XTLI=PC14/XTLO=PC15）；SVD 只有寄存器。**必须补数据手册 Pin Definitions。** 同理 **ADTIM6 各通道输出引脚与 AF 号也无法从本地得出**（`gpio.h:88` 明确"参考用户手册 GPIO 复用表"）。
14. 已验证规格：Flash 128 KB / RAM 16 KB（`hc32f072.ld`）、Cortex-M0+、LQFP48、ADC 12 bit（结果寄存器 `RESULT:12`）、ADC 外部通道 25 个（CH0–CH24，含 CHMAP=0/1 双映射表，已按通道→引脚做成完整表格）。工作电压/温度范围/最高主频**本地无据 → 未确认**。
15. 踩坑项 16 条，最值得注意：`Vc_Init()` 用 **赋值 `=` 而非 `|=`** 写 `OUT_CFG`（每通道一次只能选一条路由）；`VcOutDisable=16` 落在保留位（存疑）；`Gpio_Init()` 会强制清 AF0（顺序必须先 Init 后 SetAfMode）；`Adc_Init()` 不清 `EXTTRIGGER0/1`（残留触发源可能误触发）；`Adc_GetSqrResult()` 传 >15 枚举会越界读。

## 需要注意的限制

- 未编译、未上板验证，纯静态阅读；`VCx_OUT_CFG` 的 `VcOutDisable(16)` 行为与 ADT 死区时间物理换算需实测。

The subagent's findings materially change the design. Critically:

**VC N端没有任何 GPIO 外部输入!** Wait — but vc.h clearly listed `VcInNCh0 = PA0` etc. for VC0_N. Let me re-read:

```
en_vc_input_n_src_t:
    VcInNCh0    = 0u,         //   输入通道0  PA0               输入通道0 PC0                输入通道0 PA5
    VcInNCh1    = 1u,         //   输入通道1  PA1               输入通道1 PC1                输入通道1 PB1
    VcInNCh2    = 2u,         //   输入通道2  PA2               输入通道2 PC2                输入通道2 PE11
    VcInNCh3    = 3u,         //   输入通道3  PA3               输入通道3 PC3                输入通道3 PE15
    VcInNCh4    = 4u,         //   输入通道4  PA4               输入通道4 PA0                输入通道4 PB11
```

So VC0 N端 channel 0-7 ARE GPIO pins (PA0..PA7), channel 8-10 are PC4/PC5/DAC0, 11=ResDivOut, 12=AiTs, 13=AiBg1p2, 14=AiAdcVref, 15=AiLdo.

So the N end DOES have GPIO external input for VC0 (PA0-PA7, PC4, PC5, DAC0). The subagent got this WRONG. Let me re-read its claim: "VC 负端没有任何 GPIO 外部输入——N 端只有 16 档（N_SEL:4），除 GPIO 正端外全是内部温度/1.2V/VREF/LDO/电阻分压/DAC0/DAC1".

Actually looking at my read of vc.h directly: VC0 N end channels 0-7 = PA0..PA7 which are GPIO. So the subagent's claim is WRONG.

Wait, maybe the subagent is looking at a different thing. Let me verify directly from the header/source. This is a critical fact — it determines whether the classic "phase vs virtual neutral into P and N" works.

Let me verify carefully myself. This matters a lot.

Also its claim (c): "ADTIM6 不是三相六路 —— 单颗 ADT 只有 AdtCHxA/AdtCHxB 两个通道... 三相需 ADTIM4+5+6 三颗同步". 

Hmm! That's a significant claim. Let me check adt.h. In HC32F072, the ADT (Advanced Timer) — HC32F072 has ADTIM4/5/6? Actually HC32F072 has "3个高级定时器" or 1? Let me check. Actually HC32F072: 1个高级定时器 (ADTIM6?) Hmm. The SVD listed TIM4, TIM5, TIM6 and TIMA... 

Wait, SVD peripheral names list included "ADTIM4 ADTIM5 ADTIM6" AND "TIM4 TIM5 TIM6". Hmm, that was from a big list of register field names, not peripherals.

Hmm, this matters. Actually for HC32F072 the datasheet says: 3个高级定时器 (ADTIM4/5/6)? Or 1个? Let me verify from adt.h.

Actually, I recall HC32F072 has: TIM0/1/2 (basic), TIM3, TIM4, TIM5, TIM6 where TIM4/5/6 are advanced timers (ADTIM4/5/6) each with... Hmm. Actually in HC32F072 the ADT is one module? Let me check.

Hold on. In HC32F072 (and HC32L07x family from which HC32F072 derives), there are 3 advanced timers TIM4, TIM5, TIM6, each being a full advanced timer with 3 complementary channel pairs?? Or each with 2 channels?

Hmm, the subagent says each ADT has AdtCHxA and AdtCHxB only (2 channels), one dead-time register → 1 complementary pair. That seems odd for a "3-phase motor" MCU.

Hmm, wait. Actually I think in HC32L07x/HC32F072, TIM4/TIM5/TIM6 are "高级定时器" that support 3-phase complementary PWM with 3 channels each? Let me verify directly.

This is crucial — I must verify myself rather than trust the subagent. Let me read adt.h.

Given the importance, let me verify:
1. VC N-end GPIO input capability (from vc.h — I already read it, and it DOES list GPIO pins for N end). The subagent is wrong. But let me double check the register field in HC32F072.h for VC0_CR N_SEL width.
2. ADT channel count (adt.h).

Let me read adt.h and check.

Also I should now record the user's answers:
- source: 我马上把嘉立创EDA源文件放进文件夹 (user will put LCEDA source file in folder)
- scope: 只更新驱动板 (only update driver board)

But wait — the user chose "MCU 内置 3×VC 比较器 + 虚拟中性点" for zero-cross. Combined with "只更新驱动板", the driver board needs to route the phase-divided signals to a connector going to the MCU. The virtual neutral + dividers are on the driver board, and 4 signals (VA_sense, VB_sense, VC_sense, VN_sense) go to the MCU's VC pins.

So the driver board schematic needs:
- 3× phase divider networks
- virtual neutral network
- RC filtering
- connector with the divided signals + PWM inputs + VCC_BUS + GND
- all F1-F12 fixes

Now let me verify the two critical chip facts myself, then write the Phase 3 plan.

Let me also check the user's LCEDA file presence.

** \brief  配置VC中断触发方式
** @param  Channelx : VcChannelx  x=0、1、2
** @param  enSel : VcIrqRise、VcIrqFall、VcIrqHigh
** \retval 无
void Vc_CfgItType(en_vc_channel_t Channelx, en_vc_irq_sel_t ItType)
stc_vc_vc0_cr_field_t *stcVcnCr;
switch(Channelx)
case VcChannel0:
stcVcnCr = (stc_vc_vc0_cr_field_t*)&M0P_VC->VC0_CR_f;
break;
case VcChannel1:
stcVcnCr = (stc_vc_vc0_cr_field_t*)&M0P_VC->VC1_CR_f;
break;
case VcChannel2:
stcVcnCr = (stc_vc_vc0_cr_field_t*)&M0P_VC->VC2_CR_f;
break;
default:
break;
switch (ItType)
case VcIrqNone:
stcVcnCr->RISING  = 0u;
stcVcnCr->FALLING = 0u;
stcVcnCr->LEVEL   = 0u;
break;
case VcIrqRise:
stcVcnCr->RISING  = 1u;
break;
case VcIrqFall:
stcVcnCr->FALLING = 1u;
break;
case VcIrqHigh:
stcVcnCr->LEVEL   = 1u;
break;
default:
break;
** \brief  VC 中断使能与禁止
** @param  Channelx : VcChannelx  x=0、1、2
** @param  NewStatus : TRUE 或 FALSE
** \retval 无
void  Vc_ItCfg(en_vc_channel_t Channelx, boolean_t NewStatus)
switch(Channelx)
case VcChannel0:
SetBit((uint32_t)(&(M0P_VC->VC0_CR)), 15, NewStatus);
break;
case VcChannel1:
SetBit((uint32_t)(&(M0P_VC->VC1_CR)), 15, NewStatus);
break;
case VcChannel2:
SetBit((uint32_t)(&(M0P_VC->VC2_CR)), 15, NewStatus);
break;
default:
break;

Hmm, hold on. Let me reconsider. Actually, is there an even better approach given the VC N-end can also take an internal reference?

# CIRCUIT SPEC v2.0

## Power stage
- VCC_BUS (24–36V), GND (power)
- Q1 (A low), Q2 (A high), Q3 (B high), Q5 (B low), Q6 (C high), Q4 (C low)
  Wait, from the analysis: HO1→R6→Q2.G (A high), HO2→R5→Q3.G (B high), HO3→R4→Q6.G (C high); LO1→R1→Q1.G (A low), LO2→R2→Q5.G (B low), LO3→R3→Q4.G (C low).
  So: Phase A = Q2(high)/Q1(low); Phase B = Q3(high)/Q5(low); Phase C = Q6(high)/Q4(low).
  Let me keep the original designators to stay compatible with the user's board.
- MOSFETs HYG053N10NS1C2: G=4, S=1,2,3, D=5,6,7,8, pad 9.

## Gate drive U1 FD6288T (SOP-20)
Pins: 1=HIN1,2=HIN2,3=HIN3,4=LIN1,5=LIN2,6=LIN3,7=VCC,8=COM,
9=LO2,10=LO3,11=LO1, 12=VS2,13=HO2,14=VB2, 15=VS3,16=HO3,17=VB3, 18=VS1,19=HO1,20=VB1

Gate resistors R1..R6 = 10Ω:
- R1: LO1 → Q1.G
- R2: LO2 → Q5.G
- R3: LO3 → Q4.G
- R4: HO3 → Q6.G
- R5: HO2 → Q3.G
- R6: HO1 → Q2.G

Gate-source pulldowns (F3/F10): R7 (Q1.G–Q1.S), R8 (Q5.G–Q5.S), R9 (Q4.G–Q4.S) = 20kΩ each (reused); NEW R12 (Q2.G–Q2.S), R13 (Q3.G–Q3.S), R14 (Q6.G–Q6.S) = 20kΩ.

Bootstrap: D1–D3 anodes → VCC(12V); cathodes → VB1/VB2/VB3; C5/C6/C7 = 200nF between VBn and VSn.
- D1: VCC → VB1(20), C5: VB1–VS1(18)
- D2: VCC → VB2(14), C6: VB2–VS2(12)
- D3: VCC → VB3(17), C7: VB3–VS3(15)

VS connections: VS1(18)→phase A, VS2(12)→phase B, VS3(15)→phase C.

Low-side sources → PGND (power ground) directly (F3 fixed).

Overcurrent sensing (F9): add shunt in the low-side common source to PGND.
Design: three low-side sources join at a star point "SHUNT_TOP"; then R_shunt to PGND. 
- R_shunt: for 24-36V, motor current unknown. Let me make it a footprint with a value and design a comparator trip.
- Simpler & robust: use a 1mΩ–5mΩ shunt + comparator. But without motor current rating, pick a placeholder and document.
- FD6288T has no ITRIP. Options: use MCU's VC0 (VcOutBrake → advanced timer brake!) — but the MCU is on the control board. So send the shunt voltage to the control board and let the MCU's VC comparator do the trip + hardware brake. That's elegant and uses the chip capability we found!
  So: SHUNT+ → amplifier or direct → connector to MCU (VC input) → MCU VC → ADT brake.
  Actually VcOutBrake = "结果作为Advanced Timer刹车控制" — the ADT brake would disable PWM. 
  
  Simpler for the driver board: provide the shunt + a low-pass filter + a signal to the connector. Optionally add a local comparator with FAULT output to pull PWM low — but scope creep.
  
  Let me do: shunt R_S1 (e.g., 2mΩ, 2W, Kelvin) between star point and PGND, with a differential RC filter to the connector (ISENSE+ / ISENSE-). Plus a hardware over-current comparator on the driver board that pulls all 6 PWM inputs low via a diode-OR and reports FAULT. That's F9's option 2. Hmm, that's a meaningful addition. 

  Given "设计一份合格的工程原理图" — over-current protection is a design-quality requirement (F9 is P1). Let me include a local comparator (LM393 or similar) with a latch/FAULT. Hmm, but this adds complexity and requires more parts.

  Decision: include the shunt + differential filter to the MCU (so the MCU's VC/timer brake can do it in hardware), AND a simple local hardware trip using a comparator + diode-OR into the LIN/HIN lines, because relying on the control board for protection across a cable is bad practice for a power board. Hmm.

  Let me reconsider scope: The user asked to "对原理图进行更新实现对三相电机的驱动以及对电机位置的判定通过六步换向以及确认过零点等，最后遵守电路设计准则设计一份合格的工程原理图". So: drive 3-phase motor + position via six-step + zero-crossing; and follow circuit design guidelines. Over-current protection is part of "合格". 

  I'll include: shunt + differential RC to MCU + local over-current comparator with FAULT (open-drain) that diode-ORs into the 6 PWM inputs (pulling them low) — this is the standard "hardware protection" for a power board. Use a comparator like LM393 (dual) or a single comparator. Actually simpler and very common: use a comparator with hysteresis; or use the classic "shunt + comparator + RC latch".

  Hmm, but that requires a comparator part. Let me use LM393 (dual comparator, SOP-8) — half for over-current, half spare or for another function. Or use one channel to also do an enable. Let me keep it clean: U3 = LM393, one channel = over-current trip → FAULT + PWM pull-down; other channel = VCC_BUS 欠压/过压? That's getting complex.

  Let me simplify to a clean, defensible design:
  - U3 LM393: CH1 = 过流比较（ISENSE vs 阈值分压），输出 OC_TRIP
  - OC_TRIP drives 6 small NPN/diodes to pull the 6 PWM inputs low → immediate shutdown, independent of MCU
  - OC_TRIP also goes to connector as FAULT (open collector)
  - CH2 = 母线过压检测 → OV_TRIP (also OR'd) — optional. Let me instead use CH2 for VCC_BUS 欠压? Hmm.

  Actually — simpler and arguably better engineering: use the MCU's VC comparators for the smart protections (they have programmable DAC thresholds, filters, and hardware brake), and on the driver board implement only the *local, autonomous* over-current trip. That keeps the driver board lean.

  Hmm, but I need to decide. Let me include:
  - Shunt + differential filter → ISENSE+/ISENSE- to MCU (for software current control and MCU VC trip)
  - Local hardware OC comparator (U3 half) → pulls PWM low + FAULT
  
  That's a good balance. Let me use one LM393 (SOP-8) with the second channel used for... let me leave the second channel as a documented spare / or use it for VCC_BUS OV. I'll use it for 母线过压 (bus over-voltage) since bus pump-up is a real risk. Actually, let me make the second channel a **VCC (12V) 欠压** ... hmm.

  Let me keep it focused: second channel = VCC_BUS 过压 (>48V) → same trip. Both open-collector outputs wired-OR to the same OC/FAULT node (LM393 outputs are open collector → wired-OR works naturally). 

  That's clean, cheap, and uses the existing 10k pull-ups.

Also:
- Bus TVS + fuse (F9): add F1 fuse (or PTC) + D4 TVS (SMBJ or 5KP series per bus voltage). For 24–36V bus, a TVS rated ~45–48V standoff, e.g., SMBJ43A/SMBJ45A (600W). And a fuse.

- Bus capacitors: C15/C16/C17 47µF + C14 100µF electrolytic + C2 100nF ceramic, and add 1µF/100nF ceramics near the high-side drains (F11). We have C8/C9/C10 1µF freed up — put them as VCC decoupling per F6方案A. And add new 100nF ceramics at each half-bridge.

Hmm, the number of parts is growing. Let me be careful to keep the design coherent and not balloon. Let me settle a final BOM.

Let me now write out the full design spec as I build the generator. I'll define it in the generator data model.

Given the size, let me plan the generator architecture:

- `_gen/parts.mjs` — symbol library definitions (KiCad S-expr fragments)
- `_gen/design.mjs` — the design netlist + component list + physical placement (sheet, x, y, rotation)

This is a big build. Let me be pragmatic and structure it so the *design intent* is the source of truth (a declarative netlist), and the drawing is generated with auto-placement to reduce manual coordinate work. Auto-placement of a schematic is hard to make pretty, but I can do a reasonable job with a block-based layout.

Hmm — honestly, hand-placing ~50 components with wires to make a *readable* schematic is the hard part. An auto-router for schematics is complex.

Alternative pragmatic approach for the *drawing*: draw the schematic in a **block-diagram style with net labels** rather than full wire routing. In engineering practice, this is acceptable and common: each functional block drawn with short stubs + net labels (global labels) on every pin. This makes the drawing readable AND avoids needing a wire router. Connectivity is then defined by net labels, which KiCad and LCEDA both support (global labels / net labels).

Actually that's a really good approach: **use net labels (local/global labels) on every pin stub** instead of long wires. This is a legitimate professional style for dense schematics, is unambiguous, and is easy to generate correctly. I'll do that, with wires only for short local connections (e.g., decoupling caps to GND symbols).

So:
- Each component is placed at a coordinate.
- Each pin gets a short wire stub (e.g., 2.54mm) + a label with the net name.
- Power symbols (VCC_BUS, VCC, +5V, GND, PGND) where appropriate.

This makes generation very tractable and the result readable. 

Let me go with that.

OK, this is a large build. Let me start writing files. I'll write the design data model first.

Let me be efficient and write it in one go, carefully.

Let me define nets:

### Nets
Power:
- VCC_BUS (母线正)
- PGND (功率地)
- AGND/GND (信号地) — 单点汇合
- VCC (12V)
- SW (U2 开关节点)

Phase:

- VS1/VS2/VS3 (=PH_A/B/C for driver)
